Question: A 62-year-old woman comes to the physician for evaluation of a mole on her forearm that has increased in size over the last several months. Which of the following cellular events most likely predisposed this patient to developing this skin lesion?

opd. Formation of covalent bonds between adjacent pyrimidine bases
